---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement to a chart
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Chart**
Which chart (e.g. `bazelremote`), or a new chart proposal.

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. "To deploy on [...], I have to fork the
chart because [...]."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. If it adds configuration, sketch the value(s) and their defaults.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other approaches or workarounds (e.g. a post-render patch, a separate manifest).

**Scope check**
- [ ] Keeps environment specifics as values with generic defaults (no hardcoded registry,
      pull secret, node selector, storage class, or hostname).
- [ ] The chart still renders and validates with defaults.

**Additional context**
References, prior art, or links.
